title: Another fine myth
summary: Another Fine Myth is a humorous book of epigraphs, a collection of mock quotations arranged under section headings such as "Myth Conceptions," "Myth Directions," "Hit or Myth," and "M.Y.T.H. Inc. In Action." Each entry pairs a line of supposed wisdom with an attributed speaker, and the attributions are deliberately absurd or anachronistic, drawing on Shakespeare, Mandrake, Hamlet, Macbeth, Ulysses, Napoleon, Captain Bligh, Monty Python-style figures, pop culture characters, and famous historical figures and villains. The quotations parody the language of business advice, military strategy, self-help, and cliched proverbs, with puns on the word "myth" standing in for "might" and "mist." The book appears to belong to the fantasy gaming world of Myth Inc., a fictional organisation of mercenaries or adventurers, and the joke throughout is the gap between grand pronouncements and their bathetic or ironic sources.
